description: Canonical Platform engineering tool authority. Routers, schemas and validators must derive from this file.

cursor-cli.notes: Primary bounded implementation writer. One writer per checkout/worktree. Cannot self-certify. Requires no writerElevation.

cursor-cloud.notes: Never-writer under current policy. Elevation cannot authorize Cursor Cloud.

antigravity.notes: Read-only/adversarial by default. Independent exact-SHA auditor, negative/failure/security challenger and certification-gate evidence provider. mayCertify=false means Antigravity supplies independent certification-gate evidence/recommendation; ChatGPT + GitHub performs final technical certification. Generated adapters must not gain write tools. Task-scoped write requires explicit writerElevation on an isolated workspace; static projections remain read-only. Cannot self-certify.

codex.notes: Founder-suspended from the normal Platform workflow effective 2026-09-27 due to token/cost overhead. Retained for compatibility/provenance only (.codex/agents/ may remain; adapters stay sandbox_mode=read-only). Not an authorized writer, verifier, certification lane or elevation target while suspended. Reactivation requires an explicit future Founder governance decision.

github-copilot.notes: Never-writer. Limited auxiliary PR/code-review only. Elevation cannot authorize GitHub Copilot as writer, verifier, gatekeeper, merge authority, or sole certification evidence.

rules: default writerTool is cursor-cli and requires no writerElevation
writerTool in exceptionalWriterTools (antigravity only) requires writerElevation {authorizedBy, reason, isolatedWorkspace:true}
authorizedBy must be chatgpt-github or founder
neverWriterTools (cursor-cloud, github-copilot, chatgpt-github, founder, codex) cannot become writers via elevation
codex is Founder-suspended; prohibited from active writer/verifier/certification selection until explicit Founder reactivation
verifierTool must be distinct from writerTool
gatekeeper must be distinct from writerTool
writerTool must not equal gatekeeper for self-certification of REALITY_GATE/MERGE_READY/POST_MERGE_VERIFY/COMPLETE
generated Antigravity adapters remain read-only; task-scoped CLI elevation is outside static projection and must be explicit
Codex compatibility adapters under .codex/agents/ may remain and must stay sandbox_mode=read-only; presence does not authorize Codex use
github-copilot is never writer, verifier, gatekeeper, merge authority, or sole certification evidence
cursor-cloud is prohibited as writerTool; elevation cannot authorize it under current policy
final technical certification authority remains ChatGPT + GitHub (Antigravity mayCertify=false supplies gate evidence only)
